retrievalProfile.description: A surreal composition featuring a woman's face partially submerged in dark water under a starry night sky, focusing on intense eye contact.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, surrealist portrait where the upper half of a woman's face with blonde hair emerges from a dark, rippling body of water, set against a deep black sky filled with sparkling stars.
coreVisualRelationships: The horizontal water line bisects the face at the bridge of the nose.
The warm, golden tones of the skin and hair contrast against the cool, dark void of the sky and water.
The symmetrical placement of the face creates a focal point in the center of the frame.
The sparkling stars in the sky are mirrored by subtle glints in the water ripples.
coreInvariants: The water line must cut across the face below the eyes but above the mouth.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally aligned, occupying the middle horizontal band of the frame at a medium close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, framed by heavy dark eyeliner and blonde hair, serve as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the intense gaze, moves upward to the blonde hair and stars, then downward to the dark water ripples.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space is provided by the black sky above and the dark water below, emphasizing the subject's emergence.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black (sky and water) providing a void-like atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm gold and honey tones (hair and skin) creating a glow effect.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (star glints and eye highlights) for celestial sparkle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark environment and the illuminated face; saturation is concentrated in the warm skin tones.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, rippling water surface in the bottom half and a deep black night sky with scattered, sparkling stars in the top half.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Composite a close-up of a woman's face with blonde hair so that she appears to be rising out of the water, with the water line cutting across the bridge of her nose.

verificationChecks: Does the water line cut the face below the eyes?
Are the stars sharp and sparkling against the black sky?
Is the lighting on the face warm and glowing?

adjustableVariables: Density of stars in the sky
mustRedesign: Avoid any visible logos or text
Ensure the transition between face and water looks seamless and not like a simple crop
postGenerationChecks: Verify the water line is perfectly horizontal.
Ensure the skin tones have a warm, luminous quality.
Confirm the stars do not overlap the face unnaturally.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central submerged portrait with a cosmic night sky background using a high-contrast warm/cool color palette.
